atthavā：အတ္ထ-ဝါ （တိ）
အနက်ရှိသော။ အကျိုးရှိသော။ အစီးအပွားရှိသော။
CPD: atthava(t) , mfn. [ sa. arthavat], ( a ) useful, profit- able, significant, reasonable, cf. atthassa viññāpanī, atthavat Ja lV 254, 25 * (= hitâvahā, Ct .); Mil 172, 9 ; acc. f. °-vatiṃ vācaṃ, Ja V 374, 6 *; 375, 13 * (= kāraṇa-nissi- taṃ, Ct .); (giraṃ), Ja lV 226, 10 *; f. pl. nom. acc. °-vatī (gāthā), Ja V 151, 10 * ≠ Vv 726; SN l 30, 27 *; cf. atthavanta. — lfc. v. an- °. — ( b ) wise, knowing the truth; m. ~vā + dhammaṭṭho, Th 740, 746 (= buddhimā, Th-a).
NCP: mfn. Also written as: atthavat profitable; significant. possessing the goal; or possessing worldly knowledge See also: attha
